the older readers of the contact-time rows see the same blocks as the entries
an active timer is never billable: starting, running and pausing change none of the four figures
stop records a draft at once (never lost); it is not direct time until a person describes and saves it; units follow the rule, not the timer
entries that overlap count once (two entries for the same minutes never inflate the figures)
the active activity: said at Start in the person's own words (optional), changeable while timing, and the starting text of the stopped entry, which still has to be saved
wrong-student protection: a Harvest # that is not the student is refused; no caseload fallback; roles without Track Time are refused
the older contact-time rows hold only the student of the timer: another student's time never rides along
the timer reads the demo clock: a day advance leaves it running from the earlier day; its end is asked for, never guessed
manual correction keeps the earlier version: reason required, corrected_from, nothing edited in place
a saved entry is only confirmed by Save; changing its words is a correction with a reason
discard: a stopped timer is removed; a saved entry is voided with a reason and kept; the figures drop it
a person adds time they did not time: a reason is required and it is shown as added by hand; no future times
link to the daily note: linking is not documenting; a processed note lists the time and makes it final
a note whose time disagrees with the saved entries is flagged, not silently reconciled
units follow the configured rule only: change the bands (admin, with a reason) and the same minutes give other units
who sees time: a direct support worker their own entries; clinician all; supervisor and admin none (entries hold activity text)
microphone consent is a recorded answer per person per demo day; typing needs none; voice without it is refused
a dictation saved again replaces the waiting one; a processed (used) one is final
helpers: identity card, contact-time matching, minutes parsing

people: new users start as direct support or supervisor; clinician and administrator go through a role change

units: the alternate bands change the units a day earns; restore returns the official bands (audited)
